risk_note: RV2 (orders/**; money input). Commission snapshot compensation retry (ruling 10-19 12:3x, D10-81, D10-84): an order with an unresolved snapshot pending row retries once when a changed report goes through the pipeline (unchanged replays never retry) and from a 15-minute scan of rows due for 1 h (≤100 sub-orders per round, the pipeline's order lock with a re-read inside, one order's failure rolled back and isolated, inputs rebuilt by readSnapshotRetryInput with the settled / estimated base and the first PAID for observed paid_at; PDD (no service fee column, B1-08v) and platform_modified skipped with a warning). Snapshot and resolution in one transaction. After 24 h one temporary logger.error order.snapshot_retry_exhausted (B1-08u turns it into an alert event) and a resolution_note marker stop further retries. Workers without the snapshot port do not scan; production injection is B1-08w. No rebate_status / hold writes; money in integer fen via @couli/money.
